messages:
Lina Chen: Proposal: update structured logging JSON schema for fleet observability + sampling rules + PII redaction. Posting a concrete draft below so we can lock before the eng-sre rollout next week. Pls review and call out operational concerns.

AJ: quick thumbs-up emoji here — what's the default sampling rate? worried about losing tail errors during GPU OOM spikes.

Lina Chen: TL;DR: keep ERROR and WARN at 100%, sample INFO at 10%, DEBUG at 1%. Add conditional overrides: always keep 100% for events with error=true, and for events coming from nodes reporting >90% GPU mem. Also sample by route/model to avoid high-cardinality.

Lina Chen: Proposed log event schema (all fields optional unless marked):
```json
{
  "timestamp": "RFC3339",
  "level": "info|warn|error|debug",
  "service": "string (eg: inference-runtime)",
  "env": "string (eg: prod/us-west1)",
  "trace_id": "string",
  "request_id": "string", 
  "model": "string",
  "gpu_id": "string",
  "region": "string",
  "node": "string",
  "latency_ms": "number",
  "batch_size": "number",
  "error": "string (message)",
  "error_type": "string",
  "rows": "number",
  "user_id_hashed": "string",
  "pii_redacted": "boolean",
  "pii_fields": "array of field names (if redaction metadata needed)",
  "msg": "string",
  "raw": "string (original payload truncated)",
  "tags": "array of strings"
}
```

David Ross: lgtm on schema. Strong preference: keep request_id and any high-cardinality ids out of Loki/Grafana labels. Put them in the JSON payload only. Use trace_id for joins but as payload (not label). If we need to index by request_id, use the dedicated log indexer (not labels) to avoid cardinality blowup.

Maria P.: Important: Loki label cardinality note ^ — also do not add model + gpu_id as labels together. Use model as a label but only if we whitelist the top 20 models. Otherwise store model in payload and add derived aggregated metrics to Prom where needed.

AJ: Sampling config snippet — this is what the pipeline should support (Loki/Fluentd/Logstash filter):
```yaml
sampling:
  default:
    INFO: 0.10
    DEBUG: 0.01
    WARN: 1.0
    ERROR: 1.0
  overrides:
    - condition: "error == true"
      sample_rate: 1.0
    - condition: "gpu_mem_usage > 0.9"
      sample_rate: 1.0
    - condition: "model in [\"redwood-13b\", \"redwood-70b\"]"
      sample_rate: 0.5
  per_route_allowlist:
    - route: "/healthz"
      sample_rate: 0.01
```

Lina Chen: PII redaction approach: remove common PII patterns and hash user identifiers. Redaction is done at the edge agent (fluentd) before logs leave the cluster. Store redaction audit events in a separate encrypted index with limited retention and access. Example regexes and transform rule: replace email, phone, and full SSN-like patterns; keep a boolean pii_redacted=true plus user_id_hashed.

Lina Chen: Example redaction rules (pseudo):
```text
- email: /[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/ -> <REDACTED_EMAIL>
- phone: /(\+?\d[\d -]{7,}\d)/ -> <REDACTED_PHONE>
- ssn: /\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b/ -> <REDACTED_SSN>
- user id: /user_id=([A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,})/ -> user_id_hashed=sha256($1)
```

David Ross: Agree on edge redaction. Also: add an allowlist for team debugging: certain teams (SRE/Support) can request temporary decrypt access via ticket and we log those accesses. Keep audit trail.

AJ: One infra question: how will this affect our cost forecasting? If INFO goes 10% we still keep top-5 models at 50% — estimate storage reduction of ~65% vs today. Does that match finance projections?

Lina Chen: Ballpark: current log volume ~6 TB/day. With sampling + redaction + label pruning we expect ~2 TB/day. Finance asked for a conservative 30% reduction estimate for Q2 planning; we'll give them both numbers and show breakouts by model and region.

Maria P.: Ops concern: rolling this change across regions needs a canary. Suggest rollout plan: apply config to staging -> canary on us-east-1 (10% nodes) -> monitor error rates and SLO dashboards for 48h -> full rollout.

Lina Chen: Proposed rollout steps added to the thread below. Also linking the draft doc: https://redwood.docs.internal/logging/structured-logs-v2 (placeholder).
